injuries.icd_description: Fracture of sphenoid bone of skull

injuries.description: blunt trauma to his left eye ... diagnosed to be suffering from macula comotio retinae with reduced VA of 1/6.
source: the plaintiff also suffered from blunt trauma to his left eye and was first seen at the Hong Kong Eye Hospital on 27 September 2007 where he was diagnosed to be suffering from macula comotio retinae with reduced VA of 1/6.

injuries.description: CT cervical spine showed fractured 5th, 6th laminae and 7th spinal process
injuries.body_part: cervical spine (fractured 5th, 6th laminae and 7th spinal process)
source: (4) CT cervical spine showed fractured 5th, 6th laminae and 7th spinal process, fracture of sternum and multiple fractured ribs. All these fractures were treated conservatively with analgesics;

injuries.description: CT thorax showed left haemopneumothorax with fractured ribs; chest drain inserted; fracture of sternum and multiple fractured ribs
injuries.body_part: thorax (left haemopneumothorax; fractured ribs; fracture of sternum)
source:
(1) CT thorax showed left haemopneumothorax with fractured ribs. Chest drain
was inserted and managed by cardiothoracic surgery of Tuen Mun Hospital;
(4) CT cervical spine showed fractured 5th, 6th laminae and 7th spinal process, fracture of sternum and multiple fractured ribs. All these fractures were treated conservatively with analgesics;

injuries.description: X-ray and CT thoracolumbar spine showed bony chance fracture 11th thoracic spine, compression fracture of 12th thoracic spine and lumbar spine
source: (5) X-ray and CT thoracolumbar spine showed bony chance fracture 11th thoracic spine, compression fracture of 12th thoracic spine and lumbar spine. All of these fractures were treated conservatively with analgesics;
injuries.icd_description: Multiple fractures of lumbar spine or pelvis

injuries.description: X-ray pelvis showed fracture left superior and inferior pubic rami
injuries.body_part: left superior and inferior pubic rami (pelvis)
source:
(6) X-ray pelvis showed fracture left superior and inferior pubic rami which
were also treated conservatively.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of pubis without disruption of pelvic ring
